project_name: TripGallery (Galeria Colaborativa Privada e Segura para Viagens e Eventos)
theme_strategy: Light mode default with dark mode toggle. High contrast typography, warm sand and deep ocean blue/slate tones, tactile borders, clear visual hierarchy.

typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk / Plus Jakarta Sans / Outfit (Sans-serif with character)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono / Space Mono (for EXIF dates, coordinates, token strings, file sizes)

layout_strategies.dashboard_trips: Bento style cards (3-column grid) with cover images, member avatars stack, media count badge, trip status (active/archived), dates, and privacy status.
layout_strategies.gallery_timeline: Timeline grouped by Day (e.g. 'Dia 1 - 12 de Outubro'), masonry image grid with dynamic aspect ratios,EXIF tag pills (GPS, Camera, ISO, Date), author avatar, and quick action bar (download, share, view details).
layout_strategies.map_view: Interactive Leaflet map container with custom pin popups showcasing media thumbnail, location name, EXIF timestamp, and link to scroll to timeline item.
layout_strategies.upload_drawer: Drag and drop zone, EXIF extraction preview (Date/Time, GPS coordinates), auto tag generation, progress bars, offline queue status with auto-sync indicator.
layout_strategies.members_panel: Stats bento box ('Top Contributor', 'Most Liked Photo', 'Golden Hour Master', 'Total MB Storage') + member table/cards with role management (Owner, Editor, Viewer) and revoke access action.

key_features_and_components.language_switcher: Dropdown select or segmented pill switcher supporting PT (Português), EN (English), ES (Español) with automated translation dictionary & dynamic text updates.
key_features_and_components.dark_mode_toggle: Sun/Moon button toggle persisting state in localStorage and toggling 'dark' class on <html>.
key_features_and_components.invite_modal: Tokenized private link generator + real QR code renderer (using qrcode.react) + permissions selector (Pode visualizar / Pode enviar) + copy link button.
key_features_and_components.offline_queue: Network status detector (navigator.onLine), persistent offline upload queue stored in IndexedDB/localStorage, floating banner indicating pending uploads ready for auto-sync on reconnect.
key_features_and_components.zip_download: JSZip batch downloader organizing exported files by folders grouped by Day or Author.

instructions_to_main_agent: Make sure all files created are .js / .jsx compatible with the existing project setup.
Use lucide-react or @heroicons/react for clean minimalist travel icons.
Implement language dictionary object in src/locales/i18n.js supporting 'pt', 'en', 'es' and wrap UI text elements with translate helper t('key').
Ensure complete responsive layout with mobile bottom navigation bar or drawer for small screens.
Add testid attributes strictly matching the required_data_testids list to all main views and interactive controls.
